title: Alibi and Autopsy
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Ines Dravenmoor, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
